title: Spoken Dialogue System for Medical Prescription Acquisition on Smartphone: Development, Corpus and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing dialogue system performance metrics (such as task success rate, average time elapsed, dialogue turns, and drug association rate) across different user age groups (18-28, 29-40, 41-59, and 60+).
Comparing dialogue system performance metrics (such as task success rate, average time elapsed, and average number of events) between male and female participants.
